title: All day: Evening / Sunday open 18:00-20:00 - reclaim (long-view pick)

notes: tools/allday.py, variant reclaim|open18|pd,0.0,3,close|R3,None,eod; picked: long-view pick (2021-24, plateau score)

rules: Window: Evening / Sunday open 18:00-20:00 (entry bar inside it).
Level: the previous day's high / low (not yet taken today).
Sweep: a 5m bar trades through the level.
Reclaim: within 3 bars a 5m close back inside.
Short after a high sweep, long after a low sweep; stop 1 tick beyond the sweep extreme; the setup's own level = the box's other side.

Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); stops 6-80 pts.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
